boundary: Classical reversible Gaussian thermodynamics; no quantum battery, fabricated heat engine, Landauer violation or physical topological protection is claimed.
classical_quadratic_model: Each orthogonal mode is a unit-stiffness classical Gaussian quadratic degree of freedom. Harmonic modes start at T_H and gradient modes at T_G.
interpretation: The 81/79 topological-gradient mode imbalance creates an exactly solvable finite exergy ledger. It is a Hodge-mode thermodynamic analogy, not a device.
